title: NHK — ラーメンの真髄 (The Essence of Ramen)
description: NHK food documentary tracing ramen from its Chinese noodle origins to its evolution into a quintessentially Japanese dish. Explores regional ramen styles (博多豚骨, 札幌味噌, 喜多方醤油), the obsessive craft of broth-making, and Japan's ramen museum culture. Natural N4 Japanese with some specialist cooking vocabulary.
creator: NHK
